svg.title: Ground to orbit, as a pixel-art game screen
svg.desc: A pixel-art game screen titled World 1-1, Ground to Orbit, with a blinking Click to Start prompt. A gantry crane in a lights-out factory loads a rocket upper stage onto a driverless truck, which drives itself to the launch pad. The stage is stacked on a reusable booster, the countdown runs, the rocket lifts off, and the booster comes back and lands for a +1. In the foreground Nitish rides in a self-driving car with an empty driver's seat, raises his coffee and says Stuck it!
